args.title: Lamb Keema Dinner for Four
args.text:
# Lamb Keema Dinner for Four

**When:** Saturday 28 November 2026
**Serves:** 4

## Menu

- **Nibbles:** Poppadoms with mango chutney
- **Main:** Lamb Keema with Rice (house recipe, serves 4 as written)
- **Sides:** Cucumber & mint raita, warm garlic naan
- **Dessert:** Mango kulfi (shop-bought) with fresh mango

## Timings (aim to eat at T)

- **Earlier in the day:** Make the keema now if you like: it's better the next day, so it'll only get better by the evening. Reheat gently from T-15.
- **T-45:** Make raita: grate ½ cucumber, squeeze out the water, stir into 300 g yoghurt with chopped mint and a pinch of salt. Chill.
- **T-30:** Start the keema (brown the mince hard), per the recipe.
- **T-25:** Rinse 300 g basmati; cook it (absorption, ~12 min plus 10 min rest).
- **T-18:** Tomatoes into the keema, simmer uncovered 15 min.
- **T-10:** Warm poppadoms; serve with chutney.
- **T-6:** Peas into the keema.
- **T-5:** Naan into a hot oven.
- **T-3:** Garam masala through the keema. Serve.
- **Dessert:** Take the kulfi out 10 min before serving; slice the mango.

## Shopping

- Lamb mince, 500 g
- Onion, 1 large
- Green chillies, 2 (one for the keema, one to scatter over if you like)
- Chopped tomatoes, 1 tin
- Frozen peas, 200 g
- Basmati rice, 300 g
- Cucumber, 1
- Fresh mint, 1 bunch
- Plain yoghurt, 300 g
- Garlic naan, 4
- Poppadoms, 1 pack
- Mango chutney, 1 jar
- Mango kulfi, 4
- Ripe mango, 1

Check you have
- Garam masala
- Vegetable oil
- Salt
